note: Executor fan-out plan satisfying v0.2-v0.4 of releases/roadmap.json (the council-ratified roadmap). Each stream's research agent WRITES a JSON array to candidates/<id>.json using the Write tool (file-write pattern — schema-mode subagents are unreliable in this environment, confirmed by 2 failed council synthesis runs). The main loop then reads each file, dedups + verifies via state/ingest.mjs, and ingests.

executorDecisions.publishVsDraft: Risk PM invariant says draft-first. Deviation: ingest as status=published (the goal is content visibly ON the site) BUT capture every created ID into state/rollback-manifest.json so a bad batch can be deleted. Net: live content + reversibility.
executorDecisions.urlCheck: Honor the invariant — re-verify each URL is 200 at INGEST time (ingest.mjs + a curl pass), not only at discovery.
